fields.description_1: SoDrive is a driving school website built around helping learners understand lesson options, packages, the route to a licence and the next step toward starting lessons. The portfolio copy needed to describe that learner journey clearly rather than referring to job opportunities.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around practical driving-school information, package comparison, trust signals and clear trial-lesson or contact actions. The responsive layout keeps the same decision path easy to follow for learners on mobile and desktop.

fields.description_1: Boekhoudsnel presents bookkeeping support for entrepreneurs who want administrative work explained in practical terms. The website needed to make the service, expected support and route to contact understandable without relying on broad finance language.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the bookkeeping proposition, practical questions and a clear enquiry route. The linked URL stored in ACF was malformed and could not be independently verified, so I removed that invalid value instead of replacing it with an unverified domain.

fields.description_1: Voltworks presents energy solutions through a service-focused website where visitors need to understand the available technical options before requesting advice or a quotation. The content therefore needed to make the offer concrete instead of using generic language about enquiries.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the main energy services, supporting project information and clear contact or quotation actions. Technical detail remains available, but the first layer helps visitors identify the relevant solution and move toward a conversation.

fields.description_1: Jouwgroenteboer is an ecommerce experience for ordering fresh fruit and vegetables online. The website needed to make categories, products, delivery information and the shopping route easy to understand so customers can move from browsing to ordering without unnecessary friction.
fields.description_2: I organised the WooCommerce journey around product discovery, clear category structure and direct cart actions. Supporting information stays close to the shopping flow, while the responsive layout keeps browsing and checkout practical on smaller screens.

fields.description_1: Kervana brings installation services such as climate, heating and related technical solutions together in one WordPress presentation. The website needed to distinguish those services clearly and give visitors enough practical context before they request advice or a quotation.
fields.description_2: I structured the content around the main installation routes, project or service proof and direct enquiry actions. Shorter sections make the technical offer easier to scan, while the responsive layout keeps contact and quotation options close to the relevant service.

fields.description_1: Envolt presents electrical and energy services through a focused business website. The portfolio copy needed to explain the actual technical offer and decision path instead of using a sentence accidentally stored in the URL field and generic wording about enquiries.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around the main electrical and energy services, supporting information and clear contact actions. The malformed ACF link was replaced with the project domain, and the content now describes the service journey rather than a generic page-improvement process.

fields.description_1: Ozturk Motion Pictures is a wedding-focused visual portfolio built around films, photography, couple stories and galleries. The website needed to let prospective couples understand the style of the work quickly and move naturally from viewing previous weddings to making contact.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around visual project browsing, concise service context and a clear enquiry route. Large imagery and galleries remain the main proof, while supporting copy helps couples understand what they can request without distracting from the portfolio.

fields.description_1: Odetra presents international real-estate investment and project-development opportunities. The website needed to keep property and market information clear enough for visitors to understand the proposition before moving into company information or direct contact.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around projects, market context and the company proposition, with a clear route from evaluating opportunities to making an enquiry. The content hierarchy keeps property information central and avoids generic claims that could apply to any real-estate website.

fields.description_1: Marco Verhuurt is a rental-focused website where visitors need to understand the available offer, practical conditions and availability before making an enquiry. The portfolio copy therefore needed to describe the rental journey directly instead of speaking generally about page clarity.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the rental options, availability and the next contact step. Practical information appears before the enquiry point, giving visitors enough context to decide whether an available option fits their needs.

fields.description_1: Palmero Shop is an ecommerce site for massage guns and recovery accessories. Product education, supporting articles, FAQs, delivery and return information all need to work together so customers understand the products before they decide to buy.
fields.description_2: I structured the WooCommerce experience around product-led browsing, clear product explanations and a direct shopping route. Educational content supports the purchase decision without interrupting it, while store policies and FAQs remain easy to reach before checkout.

fields.description_1: Solar Daktechnique presents solar panels, charging solutions and related electrical work through a technical energy-services website. Visitors needed to understand the available solutions and the company’s practical role before requesting a quotation or making contact.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the main energy-service choices, supporting technical information and clear quotation routes. The first layer stays easy to scan, while deeper detail remains available for visitors who want to compare solutions before enquiring.

fields.description_1: Netural Home combines sanitary products, floors, tiles and renovation projects with showroom advice. The website needed to work as an inspiration layer first, then help visitors translate what they see into a practical appointment or quotation.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around product and renovation categories, project inspiration and tailored showroom advice. Visitors can browse ideas, understand the available interior options and move naturally toward an appointment or quote without losing the visual focus.

fields.description_1: Oxford Academy brings tutoring, homework guidance, exam preparation, remedial support and school services together across its education offering. The website needed to help parents and students understand those options, locations and approach before choosing a trial lesson or signup route.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around the main education services, the academy’s step-by-step approach, teacher and review proof and clear registration actions. The structure keeps the different forms of support distinct while making the next step easy to find.

fields.description_1: Marcos Montage is an installation-services website, not an exhibition or gallery project. The website needed to explain the practical technical work clearly and give prospective customers a direct route from the relevant service to quotation or contact.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around concise service information and visible enquiry actions. The corrected portfolio copy removes the unrelated gallery references and describes the actual installation-focused customer journey across desktop and mobile.

fields.description_1: Home Plaza covers kitchens, bathrooms, floors, wall finishes, steel doors, custom cabinetry, stair renovation and complete home renovation. The website needed to make that broad interior offer browsable while connecting inspiration and showroom information to a practical project process.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the main renovation categories, project steps and showroom proof. Visitors can move from exploring a specific part of the home to arranging an appointment or quotation, while the overall presentation still feels like one complete renovation proposition.

fields.description_1: Brightlyn is a cybersecurity and regulatory consultancy whose services cover risk, resilience, DORA, NIS2 and assurance. The website needed to translate complex advisory subjects into clear service routes while showing the sectors and end-to-end approach behind the work.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the main cybersecurity and compliance needs, sector context and direct consultation options. The structure makes technical regulation easier to scan without oversimplifying the expertise, helping business visitors identify the relevant advisory route.

fields.description_1: YCO IT focuses on risk management and compliance, including subjects such as ISAE, ISO 27001 and 27701, control concepts and security or compliance assessments. The website needed to make those specialist services understandable to organisations evaluating governance and assurance support.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the main compliance and risk topics, practical assessment routes and clear contact points. Technical standards remain visible as proof of scope, while the page hierarchy helps visitors identify which service matches their organisation’s need.

fields.description_1: DM Elektro presents electrical systems, lighting, solar solutions, batteries, heat pumps and maintenance through one technical-services website. The challenge was to keep the breadth of that offer understandable while giving visitors enough trust and service context before requesting a quote.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content into distinct electrical and energy routes, supported by expertise and certification information. Clear quotation and contact actions stay close to the relevant service, making it easier to move from a technical need to a concrete enquiry.

fields.description_1: Fixfinder helps motorists start with their vehicle and then find support for maintenance, repairs, tyres, keys, towing, damage or cleaning. The website needed to make that service-selection process simple enough that visitors can move from a problem to a relevant partner garage without guessing.
fields.description_2: I structured the experience around entering the vehicle, choosing the required service and continuing toward an appropriate repair provider. Supporting explanations clarify the available categories while keeping the main task—finding the right automotive help—central on desktop and mobile.

fields.description_1: VoiceLinq provides interpreting and translation services with a network covering more than 50 languages and sectors such as legal, medical and business communication. The website needed to separate service requests from the route for interpreters who want to join the network.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around interpreting, translation and the two primary user journeys: requesting language support and becoming an interpreter. Clear service context and direct actions keep the broad language offer practical instead of abstract.

fields.description_1: QuickTemp connects candidates and employers across sectors including hospitality, production, logistics and horticulture. The website needed to keep job discovery and flexible staffing enquiries separate while using the same sector expertise to support both audiences.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around vacancies and candidate action on one side, and employer staffing needs on the other. Clear sector routes, practical information and direct contact actions help each audience move forward without sorting through the other journey.

fields.description_1: VC Het Wonder is a healthcare website focused on maternity care around pregnancy, birth and the postnatal period. The portfolio copy needed to describe that care journey calmly and clearly rather than using generic language about a healthcare organisation.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around care information, locations and contact, using a calm hierarchy that helps expectant parents find the relevant stage of care. The public project site could not be fully fetched during verification, so I kept the corrected claims limited to the live WordPress project data.

fields.description_1: Starkeuken presents fitted kitchens and related interior products such as appliances, worktops and tiles, with additional bathroom and sanitary options across its locations. The website needed to turn that broad showroom offer into a clear route from inspiration to advice.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around the main kitchen and interior categories, practical product information and location or contact routes. Visitors can compare options, understand the range and move toward showroom advice without the content feeling like generic kitchen marketing.

fields.description_1: Modern Image Manager is a WordPress media-management plugin for reviewing image metadata, importing and exporting updates, scanning where images are used and creating controlled media ZIP exports. The workflow needed to support bulk maintenance without weakening validation or file-handling safety.
fields.description_2: I built the admin workflow around metadata review, usage scanning, CSV-based updates and controlled export actions. Capability checks, validation and safer file boundaries keep large media tasks manageable while giving administrators a clearer overview of the library.

fields.description_1: WeHear4U is a healthcare project where visitors need calm, accessible information about care and treatment before deciding to make contact. The portfolio copy needed to reflect that patient-facing journey rather than describe generic improvements to a healthcare page.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around clear care information, a calm reading hierarchy and visible contact options. The public project site presented a verification challenge during the audit, so the corrected wording stays within the scope confirmed by the live WordPress project data.
